# A quieter way to browse

Everything you need to look through a project, in one place.

![A simple landscape](landscape.svg)

## Made for the files you already have

| File | Preview |
| --- | --- |
| Markdown | Formatted notes, lists, and tables |
| Images | A full, fitted view |
| Python | Readable, highlighted source |
| Text | Simple monospace text |

> A little clarity goes a long way.

```python
from pathlib import Path

for file in Path.cwd().iterdir():
    print(file.name)
```

Open the [Python example](sample.py) or the [plain text note](notes.txt).
